brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is drawing criticism from economists and political rivals after suggesting Israel could use cryptocurrency to shield its economy from sanctions, Al-Monitor reported. The proposal emerged as Netanyahu prepares for re-election this week.

Critics have questioned whether the approach would work and whether it complies with international law. The government has not yet responded in detail to the objections.

title: Netanyahu faces backlash over cryptocurrency sanctions plan
